title: Setup → Email Template: a template carried in two locales lists as two rows, but both rows open the same locale, so the other language cannot be opened or edited from Setup
body:
Ruled: 6444406836 · letter A · 2026-10-27T14:18Z

Filing gate: ① product defect, user-visible, reproduced in Setup (`@objectstack/*` 18.2.0).

## Reproduce

1. Boot any app whose stack declares an `email_template` bundle in two locales. Measured with objectstack-ai/duly `main` at `c20d397` (`pnpm demo`), which ships `duly.task_overdue` as `en` and `zh-CN`. The platform's own `auth.*` bundles carry several locales too.
2. Open Setup → Email Template (`/_console/apps/setup/metadata/email_template?scope=environment`). `duly.task_overdue` shows as **two rows**, "任务逾期升级提醒 — 负责人" and "Task overdue escalation — owner". The list has no locale column.
3. Click either row. Both navigate to the same URL, `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/metadata/email_template/duly.task_overdue?scope=environment`, and both open the **same** member. Measured: an en-US browser and UI opened `zh-CN` from both rows, with Locale `zh-CN` and label 任务逾期升级提醒 — 负责人.

So one language of every multi-locale template can be listed but never opened, previewed or edited from Setup.

## The server already supports it

`GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/duly.task_overdue?member=en` returns the `en` row, and `?member=zh-CN` returns the `zh-CN` row. That is ruling `6116165299` letter A, and #23073 made the draft list and commit timeline carry `member`. The Setup list → detail path does not carry it: the row link is built from `name` alone, and the detail read sends no `member`.

Landing point (read, not yet changed): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx` (row navigation) and `ResourceRouter.tsx` (detail read), both in `domain:ui`.

## Expected

- Each row opens its own member, with the member in the route or query, e.g. `?member=en`.
- The list shows which member a row is, for example a Locale column for a member-discriminated type.

## Business reason

Who benefits: an administrator customizing outbound wording, which is the template-app path ("change the words without code"). The scenario: an operator wants to adjust the English reminder text and can only ever reach the Chinese one. Without the fix, a second language is read-only in Setup, and the only way to it is the REST door with a query parameter the UI never shows.

## Reader

`domain:ui` execution seat, after central triage.

## Duplicate check

These queries in objectstack-ai/objectstack:
- `Setup email template list two locales same name both rows open the same locale editor route keyed by name`
- `metadata resource list email_template member link detail page does not pass member selector second language`

They returned 10 and 1 hits, all closed. The closest is #23073 (closed): the lists carry `member` for drafts and commits, and Studio's half was objectui#12271 (the draft panel and commit timeline). Neither covers the Setup resource list → detail route.
